description: 한국도로공사_대전충청권출발 지역간 월누계교통량 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로공사. 본 데이터는 한국도로공사가 대전충청권에서 출발한 고속도로 이용 차량의 월별 지역 간 교통량을 집계하여 제공하는 통계자료이다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로공사. Its tags are 교통수요, 권역분석, 차량통행량, 차종통계, 물류흐름. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
